title: Archive Orientation / New User Guide
summary: Basic instructions for retrieving records and navigating connected archive material.
body:
WELCOME TO THE BRIGHTSIDE ARCHIVAL NETWORK.

This terminal retrieves records by reference number. The archive index is intentionally incomplete. Not every record held by the network is displayed here.

HOW TO RETRIEVE A RECORD
Enter a complete record reference in the RECORD REFERENCE field and select RETRIEVE.

Example: ARC-326-0002

The example above opens a short navigation exercise. Follow the links within it before returning here if you are unfamiliar with connected records.

RECORD CLASSIFICATIONS
PUBLIC records can be opened normally.
RESTRICTED records require an archive access key.
WITHDRAWN records remain in the archive index but are not available for normal access.
CORRUPTED records may contain incomplete or damaged copies.
UNVERIFIED records have not been independently confirmed by the archive.

NAVIGATION
Records may cite other records under RELATED RECORDS. Selecting one of these links opens the cited record and records where you came from. A RETURN TO PREVIOUS RECORD section will appear at the top of the next record.

Record references may also be entered directly when known.

Do not assume that the absence of a record from this page means that no such record exists.
